product.name: Monoprice 8K Ultra High Speed Slim HDMI Cable - 8K@60Hz 4K@120Hz 48Gbps HDR VRR 1ft Black
product.description: Ultra Slim 8K Ultra High Speed HDMI® Cables are the next generation of HDMI cables. Supporting resolutions up to 8K@60Hz and 48Gbps bandwidth, this future proofed cable just might be the last HDMI cable you'll ever need. 48Gbps is the bandwidth required to support all features found in the HDMI 2.1 specification. It supports Dynamic HDR to take full advantage of HDR's expanded contrast ranges, brightness levels, and heightened levels of detail, optimized on a scene-by-scene or even a frame-by-frame basis. This cable complies with the HDMI 2.1 standard, which makes it compatible with the latest hardware, including the PlayStation® 5, PlayStation® 5 Digital Edition, Xbox Series X™, and Xbox Series S™.  Supports 8K@60Hz and 4K@120HzDynamic HDR48Gbps BandwidthUltra Slim DesignSupports 8K@60Hz and 4K@120Hz: The 8K@60Hz resolution delivers a more immersive viewing experience, with sharper high speed content, while the 4K@120Hz resolution produces ultra fast and sharp images, which are great for sports, high performance gaming, and VR.Dynamic HDR: Dynamic HDR ensures that every moment of a video is displayed with its ideal depth, detail, brightness, contrast, and a wider color gamut, optimized on a scene-by-scene or even a frame-by-frame basis.48Gbps Bandwidth: These cables deliver 48Gbps bandwidth, which helps prevent handshake issues, snow, video noise, and other anomalies. They fully support high bandwidth dependent video and audio features, such as Dynamic HDR, Dolby Vision™, Dolby Atmos®, and DTS:X®.Ultra Slim Design: The ultra slim design makes the cable more flexible, so they can fit better in tight spaces with ultra slim wall mounts and making cable management easier.  Fully supports all features found in the HDMI® 2.1 specificationSupports all HDMI resolutions up to 8K@60Hz, including 4K@120Hz, 3D video, and multiview videoSupports Dynamic HDR (High Dynamic Range) for brighter, deeper, and more lifelike colorsSupports extended CEC (Consumer Electronics Control) commands and functions, the HDMI Ethernet Channel, and the eARC (Enhanced Audio Return Channel) featuresSupports AMD® FreeSync™ on the PlayStation® 4 Pro, Xbox Series X™, and Xbox Series S™ consolesSupports SA-CD, DVD-Audio, DTS-HD Master Audio™, Dolby TrueHD™, and other high-definition audio standardsSupports the 21:9 cinema aspect ratioSupports up to 32 audio channels and a 1536kHz audio sampling rateSupports Deep Color with up to 16-bits per channel, including the Sony® x.v.Color™ standardSupports simultaneous delivery of dual video streams to multiple users on the same screenSupports Game Mode VRR, which produces a more fluid and better detailed gameplay experienceBuy with confidence with the Monoprice™ Lifetime Warranty on all cables  Lifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
